long_biography.plain_text:
Christophe Votat learnt high-latitude seamanship through years of work across the Southern Ocean. After leaving France in 2007, he sailed widely and spent more than seven years in Patagonia and Antarctica. Severe weather made preparation, repair skills and calm decision-making central to his work.

His partnership with outdoor guide Emmanuelle Dumas turned that experience into LifeSong Sailing. Their small-group expeditions link ocean passages with skiing, hiking and sea kayaking in Greenland, Svalbard and Norway. As captain, Votat plans routes, maintains the sailing platform and manages safety at sea. The business has remained deliberately personal in scale.
